title: A Study to Evaluate the Efficacy and Safety of Rosuvastatin in Children and Adolescents With Homozygous Familial Hypercholesterolemia

sections.abstract:
The purpose of the study is to establish the efficacy, safety and tolerability of rosuvastatin in children and adolescents with homozygous familial hypercholesterolemia.

Posted outcomes: LDL-Cholesterol (mg/dL). timeframe=Samples taken on Day 42 (week 6) and on day 84 (week 12). C-FAS Rosuvastatin=396.0 (±195.99); C-FAS Placebo=481.4 (±184.90). p=0.005
